title: Fix the smaller PR #34 review findings
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

(1) setStarterButtonState (options.ts): offer?.adapter !== null is true when offer is null. (2) hasAdapter (starter-adapters.ts) can't see an existing GitHub adapter until an org scope is typed. (3) StoredAdapters uses deny_unknown_fields, so a newer [adapters] key makes the whole config unreadable (backup-and-rewrite) instead of just suspending adapter policy. Confirm each with a failing test first.

From the PR #34 code review, which was not separately verified: confirm with a failing test before fixing.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test reproducing the reported failure fails before the fix and passes after; the full Rust and extension suites are green. If the test shows the finding is wrong, close as not reproduced with the reason.
close_reason: Shipped all three failing-first adapter review repairs; full gate green (cycle commit pending)

title: Stop removal of an adapter or site from re-confirming every later adapter
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

host/src/consent.rs ~808 approval_lines. An index shift reads as a policy change, so revoking one site asks to re-enable each later unscoped adapter; with ~29+ unscoped adapters it passes the 8192-byte cap and refuses the removal. Contradicts DESIGN 'Removing or narrowing them takes effect immediately'. Compare by identity, not index. Confirm with a failing test first.

From the PR #34 code review, which was not separately verified: confirm with a failing test before fixing.

title: Close the id-template freeze bypass
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

host/src/config.rs ~1234. Removals are never checked and identity is (origin, type), so jira.issue can be removed and re-added with a new id, or type and id changed in one edit, orphaning artifact records. Contradicts 'impossible for a config edit to orphan activity'. Decide the intended rule (e.g. remember retired ids per origin), then enforce it. Confirm with a failing test first.

From the PR #34 code review, which was not separately verified: confirm with a failing test before fixing.

title: Restore a repair path while adapter_issue is set
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

host/src/consent.rs ~336, extension/options.ts ~161 and ~517. Every write echoing the stored adapter document fails full validate(), including harness setup, denylist and folder changes; the UI disables every adapter control and refuses format != 1. Breaks 'notes and AI settings remain usable during adapter repair'. Non-adapter writes must succeed and the UI needs a way to replace or remove the bad document. Confirm with a failing test first.

From the PR #34 code review, which was not separately verified: confirm with a failing test before fixing.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test reproducing the reported failure fails before the fix and passes after; the full Rust and extension suites are green. If the test shows the finding is wrong, close as not reproduced with the reason.

title: Fix adapter removal refused when two adapters share origin and type
description:
## Steps to Reproduce

Two work.issue adapters on one origin (/issues id X, /tickets id Y): removing the second fails with a misleading 'id template ... cannot change' error; same when adaptersForSites drops only one of the pair. title: Make the dialog reply test consume its request
description: The final brwr-flu verification intermittently failed in dialog::tests::a_dialog_that_answers_in_time_keeps_its_reply: its /bin/sh child exits after printf canceled without reading the parent request, so the parent can race into EPIPE while writing. The test passed at the opening health gate and in isolation; production dialog children read the length-prefixed request before replying.
acceptance_criteria: The fake reply child reads the complete framed request before answering, the regression is exercised repeatedly without Broken pipe, and the full Rust suite is green.

title: Group cross-tool work into named focus sessions
description: Recent and the worklog explain which artifacts were active, but they cannot express why a Jira issue, design document, and pull request belonged to the same deliberate block of work. Add an explicit local focus session a user can start/name/end from the panel; associate measured activity with its stable session identity and surface the grouped trail in the worklog without inferring intent or contacting a service.
acceptance_criteria: DESIGN.md defines session ownership, privacy, restart, overlap, and append-only log contracts; the panel can start, display, rename, and end one active session; worker restart preserves it; activity and the derived worklog group exact artifacts under it; tests cover hour boundaries, restart, pause, rename, and an artifact active across two sessions; the full suite is green.

title: Offer non-destructive adapter document repair
description: The brwr-rhg recovery path deliberately removes the whole invalid adapter document. Give users a copy-out and whole-document replacement workspace so a malformed entry can be repaired without discarding otherwise useful rules, while never interpreting or auto-migrating an unsupported future format.
acceptance_criteria: When adapter_issue is present, settings can copy the preserved raw document and submit a complete format-1 replacement through TypeScript preview, revision checking, native authorization, and host validation; stale revisions and still-invalid replacements are refused; reset-all remains available; focused tests cover unsupported formats and malformed artifacts.

title: Make first-tool setup one coherent transaction
description: Cookie's own proposal, only after the plan work. Let a new user choose Jira, SharePoint/OneDrive or GitHub first, enter the exact tenant and any required scope, then request Chrome access and native-confirm the site plus starter together. Roll back a newly acquired grant on cancel; retain it when notes or another site purpose already needs it.
acceptance_criteria: A new user can pick a tool, scope it, and confirm site plus starter in one native confirmation; cancel rolls back a newly acquired Chrome grant; tests cover rollback and retained-grant cases.
notes: When composing first-tool setup, show installed GitHub PR and issue owner scopes separately; do not infer one shared editable scope when their policies differ.
